# Pivot and support

## Rule

One high reference. The pivot holds the last man. Support plays under the ball, not on top of the pivot. If both go high, there is nobody to play through.

## Cue

Highest player pins. Nearest player shows under. The rest rotate. See [[taking-space]] (`taking-space`) for the vacated lane.
